headline_marked: [[WhatsApp starts rolling out username support]] when creating new contacts
headline: WhatsApp starts rolling out username support when creating new contacts
summary: WhatsApp is now allowing users to save a contact's username alongside their name and phone number, signaling an approaching official rollout of the feature.
details: WhatsApp has begun rolling out support for usernames, allowing users to save this new identifier when creating or editing contacts. This feature integrates directly into the app's 'New contact' interface, appearing alongside traditional name and phone number fields.

This move precedes the official launch of usernames, which is expected to enable users to connect on the platform without needing to share their phone numbers. The current implementation suggests a staged rollout, preparing the groundwork for broader availability.
caption:
WhatsApp is finally getting usernames! You can now save them for contacts.
